doc: Adoption sidecar of M3 (format: the docstring of holon.sorts.reextract; read by holon.diagram.linked as the adoption sidecar of holon codecs). Authored in the blind rerun from the tooling code and docstrings only: it adopts the extracted holon-facts/0.3 documents that spec/M3/lib/link.json names, so that the link role whose Solidity source is a loader edge and whose Go source is a tagged predicate forms a component (rule X1 of holon.diagram.linked). No re-extraction and no SORT-width derivation are switched on.
